# Reference

## Summary

This section contains reference information for node builders.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference.md

---

This section contains reference information for node builders. It covers node UI elements, key parameters in your node's base and credentials files, and the guidelines for submitting your node for [verification by n8n](/integrations/community-nodes/installation-and-management/install-verified-community-nodes).

## In this section

* [Node UI elements](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/node-ui-elements): the predefined UI components available for your node's parameters.
* [Code standards](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/code-standards): good code practices for node building.
* [Error handling](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/error-handling): the error classes n8n provides for node implementations.
* [Versioning](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/versioning): make changes to an existing node without breaking its current behavior.
* [Base files](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/base-files): the core code of your node, for declarative and programmatic styles.
* [Codex files](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/codex-files): the JSON file that holds your node's metadata.
* [Credentials files](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/credentials-files): define the authorization methods for your node.
* [HTTP request helpers](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/http-request-helpers): make HTTP requests from your node.
* [Item linking](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/item-linking): link output items back to the items that generated them.
* [UX guidelines](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/ux-guidelines): the UI conventions a verified community node must follow.
* [Verification guidelines](/connect/create-nodes/build-your-node/reference/verification-guidelines): the requirements for n8n to verify your community node.
